confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear pattern of data exfiltration by user_02. While the user's role allows access to engineering and project directories, the activity occurred from an unusual IP and significantly outside normal working hours, culminating in a high volume of large file downloads (including a .tar.gz archive) during a late-night session.

attack_chain.description: User_02 logs in from an unusual IP (103.28.45.67) outside of normal working hours.
Initial data collection: user_02 downloads a system design PDF.
User_02 initiates a second session late at night (21:30) from the same unusual IP.
Bulk data exfiltration begins with the download of a large infrastructure diagram.
Significant exfiltration of a compressed archive (load_test_results.tar.gz) totaling ~9MB.

gaps: Verification of whether the unusual IP (103.28.45.67) is a known company VPN or associated with the user's recent travel.
Confirmation of whether the large downloads were part of a scheduled backup or deployment task.
narrative: User_02 exhibited highly suspicious behavior by accessing the environment from an unusual IP address during off-hours. The pattern transitioned from standard file reading to a concentrated burst of large file downloads and archive exfiltration during a late-night session, suggesting unauthorized data collection.
